sql_query.query: UPDATE _medication SET name = COALESCE($1, name), dosage = COALESCE($2, dosage), unit = COALESCE($3, unit), frequency = COALESCE($4, frequency), timeOfDay = COALESCE($5, timeOfDay), notes = COALESCE($6, notes), active = COALESCE($7, active), refillDate = COALESCE($8, refillDate), refillReminder = COALESCE($9, refillReminder), updatedAt = $10 WHERE id = $11 AND careRecipientId IN (SELECT id FROM _care_recipient WHERE primaryCaregiverId = $12)
